posts.title: Why Winnow Won't Ship in China or France
posts.description: Lightning has to encrypt. France wants that declared to its Prime Minister, and China wants a registered operator for an app it calls illegal. Winnow will ship to neither.

posts.title: A Tailscale Workaround for Tor and I2P
posts.description: Winnow still does not bundle Tor or I2P. This is how it reaches them anyway, through gateways you run yourself, and how to build those gateways.

posts.title: One in Twelve Peers Is on a Dead Chain
posts.description: A stalled mainnet test, a dead fork, and a census of every reachable Bitcoin node
